commit_message: Rebase ADR0156 campaign core onto runtime debugging
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebases ADR 0156 benchmark campaign orchestration onto the latest main after ADR 0157 landed. Adds schema-v2 campaign execution identity, strict immutable plan/evidence matching, deterministic sequential scheduling, exact preflight/resume identity, failure-preserving retries, Windows-safe progress persistence, and task policies aligned with the production ADR 0157 runtime-debug surface.

AI Studio campaign launcher/executor integration follows on this same Draft PR after this core baseline is green.
